title: Network Requests with PowerShell
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Network Requests with PowerShell and define its core vocabulary.

content.intro: This lesson covers Network Requests with PowerShell in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: External integrations fail in ordinary ways: credentials expire, requests time out, services paginate and payload schemas change. Validate the endpoint and response, use secure authentication, parameterize database access, and bound retries so a failed service cannot cause an unending loop.

content_blocks.title: Version and safety note
content_blocks.text: The main path targets modern PowerShell 7.6 LTS. Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility is labeled separately. Some providers, admin cmdlets and APIs depend on OS, module version, permissions or tenant access; the examples are static references, not proof of execution.
